title: Module Workstation
keywords: Edits modules inside a Flawless Calculator

blocks.text: Edits modules inside a Flawless Calculator. Removing the calculator takes its installed contents with it.

rows: Insert the Flawless Calculator in its labelled slot.
Install supported modules into the module slots.
Remove it and sneak-use it to choose an installed action.

blocks.text: Atomic Module and ordinary assembly ingredients are not automatically usable modules. See the installation chapter for accepted categories.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
